svg.aria-label: A separately constructed first-order ethanol-like model uses 3:2 total areas, 7.1 Hz coupling and T₂*=0.20 s. A shows the real FID; B transforms the same data; C adds 3 Hz exponential broadening; D compares actual acquisition durations with equal zero filling. This is not the BMRB raw time-domain experiment.
